# gitmoap_repository_pipeline_component_file (Data Source)

Read one component's files at a ref. Every file the component is written in, as committed; the body they say, with its names bound to what they name in your organization now and the components it uses kept as written; the parts the files compute rather than write, which only an edit of the files changes; every diagnostic with its file, line and column; and the pipelines that use it. Reads the default branch unless a ref or a commit is named — never both.

The token needs `pipeline:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gitmoap_repository_by_path" "api" {
  full_path = "acme/platform/api"
}

# The go-build component as its files hold it on the default branch, with what they compute and
# every diagnostic.
data "gitmoap_repository_pipeline_component_file" "go_build" {
  repo_id        = data.gitmoap_repository_by_path.api.repository_id
  component_name = "go-build"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component_name` (String) The component's name: its file's name without the extension, or its directory's name
- `repo_id` (String) Repository id

### Optional

- `commit_sha` (String) A commit to read instead of a ref's tip
- `ref` (String) A branch, a tag or a full ref; the default branch when absent

### Read-Only

- `blob_sha` (String) Its file's git object id, or its directory's tree id.
- `body` (Attributes) What a component contains: its stage slots, parameters, steps, connections and the ports it
exposes. Drafts and published versions share this shape. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body))
- `computed` (Attributes List) Every part of the body the files compute rather than write. An editor shows these
read-only: a change to one is made in the files. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--computed))
- `description` (String) What it is for, as its files' `description` says.
- `diagnostics` (Attributes List) Every problem the component has and everything worth saying about it, file by file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics))
- `files` (Attributes List) Every file it is written in, as committed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--files))
- `name` (String)
- `path` (String) Where it is written: its file, or its directory.
- `published` (Attributes) What this repository has published under a component's name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--published))
- `source_map` (Attributes List) Where each part of `body` is written in `files`, and how a value the files compute or
repeat came by it. Empty when there is no `body`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_map))
- `used_by` (List of String) Every pipeline at the ref that uses it, directly or through another of the repository's
components.
- `versioning` (String) Which tags publish a component: only its own `<name>/vX.Y.Z`, or also the repository's plain
`vX.Y.Z` releases.

<a id="nestedatt--body"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body`

Read-Only:

- `component_instances` (Attributes List) Other components this component uses. Always empty in a published version, where they have
already been expanded into steps. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--component_instances))
- `edges` (Attributes List) Connections between the component's own steps; both ends must be steps of this component. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--edges))
- `inputs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--inputs))
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes))
- `outputs` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--outputs))
- `parameters` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--parameters))
- `stage_slots` (List of String) The positions the component's steps occupy, in order. A pipeline using the component maps
each slot to one of its own stages.

<a id="nestedatt--body--component_instances"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body.component_instances`

Read-Only:

- `component_id` (String)
- `component_ref` (String)
- `condition` (String) On which runs a step runs, or which of two values a choice takes, decided when a run starts from what the run knows then: its event, branch, tag, commit, merge request, schedule and repository, and the values a person started it with. `true` or `false`, or an object with exactly one operator key: a comparison of two operands, `&&` and `||` over two conditions, `!` over one, `contains`, `startswith`, `endswith` and `strcontains`, or a boolean read alone. A condition decides what a run does, never who may do it: anyone who can push a branch or a tag can make one true for their own run.

JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `params` (String) JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `stage_map` (Map of String) Binds every slot the referenced component declares to a slot of the **containing** body.
- `version` (String)

- `target_node_id` (String)
- `target_port` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--body--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body.nodes`

Read-Only:

- `node` (Attributes) A step in a stage: one use of a provider capability, with its configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--node))
- `param_slots` (Attributes) Step fields whose values a component parameter supplies, each naming the parameter to take the
value from. A step's `config` reads parameters directly instead, with `{"$param": "<name>"}`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--param_slots))
- `stage_slot` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--body--nodes--node"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body.nodes.node`

Read-Only:

- `allow_failure` (Boolean) When `true`, this node's failure (a non-zero exit or a timeout, after any
retries) is non-blocking: it does not fail the enclosing stage or the run.
The node's transitive dependents — which can never receive its output —
are skipped, while independent branches and later stages keep running. A
run whose only failures were `allow_failure` nodes finishes
`succeeded_with_warnings`.
- `approval` (Attributes) An approval gate on a step. With no `approvers`, anyone with Developer access to the repository
may decide; a list narrows the decision to the people, teams and roles it names, as they stand
when the approval is given. On a step that deploys to an environment requiring approval, the
list may only name approvers the environment also names. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--node--approval))
- `capability_id` (String)
- `changes` (List of String) Path globs that decide whether this step runs: when none of them matches a path the push
changed, the step is skipped. When absent and `service` is set, the service's own path globs
apply.
- `condition` (String) On which runs a step runs, or which of two values a choice takes, decided when a run starts from what the run knows then: its event, branch, tag, commit, merge request, schedule and repository, and the values a person started it with. `true` or `false`, or an object with exactly one operator key: a comparison of two operands, `&&` and `||` over two conditions, `!` over one, `contains`, `startswith`, `endswith` and `strcontains`, or a boolean read alone. A condition decides what a run does, never who may do it: anyone who can push a branch or a tag can make one true for their own run.

JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `config` (String) The step's provider-specific configuration, checked against the capability's
`config_schema` when the run starts.

JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `connection` (String)
- `cpu` (String)
- `environment` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `matrix` (Attributes) The dimensions a step's matrix expands over. Every combination of their values becomes one copy
of the step, always in the same order: dimensions sorted by name, values in the order written. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--node--matrix))
- `max_retries` (Number)
- `memory` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `resource_group` (Attributes) A resource group a step holds while it runs, so only one step naming it runs at a time. Unless
`mode` says otherwise, a step queues for the group, for as long as the pipeline's timeout
allows unless `max_wait_seconds` sets a shorter limit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--node--resource_group))
- `retry_delay_seconds` (Number)
- `service` (String)
- `timeout_seconds` (Number)
- `variables_from` (String)
- `version` (String)

- `team` (String)

Set one of `group` or `repo`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--body--nodes--node--approval--approvers--role--at))

<a id="nestedatt--body--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `body.parameters`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_values` (List of String) The only values this parameter accepts. Absent means any value of its type. On a published
parameter, adding this list or removing a value from it is a major version change; adding a
value is a minor one.
- `default` (String) JSON: set it with `jsonencode()`.
- `description` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `param_type` (String) The JSON shape a parameter's value must have.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether a pipeline using the component must supply a value. A required parameter cannot
have a default.



<a id="nestedatt--computed"></a>
### Nested Schema for `computed`

Read-Only:

- `element` (String) The part, named as a render's conflict names one: `step "<id>": <field>`,
`param "<name>": <field>`, `input "<port>": <field>`, `output "<port>": <field>` or
`component "<id>": <field>`.
- `reason` (String) Why the files hold it rather than write it: an expression computes it, an instance a
`for_each` makes holds it, or the directory's `defaults` supplies it.


<a id="nestedatt--diagnostics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `diagnostics`

Read-Only:

- `code` (String) A stable code: a `syntax_*`, `unsupported_*`, `schema_*` or `reference_*` code of the
language, or a pipeline validation rule's own name.
- `fix` (Attributes) A replacement that fixes a diagnostic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--fix))
- `location` (Attributes) A span of a file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--location))
- `message` (String) What is wrong, in a sentence that names it.
- `related` (Attributes List) Other places that matter to it — the other half of a duplicate, the rest of a cycle. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--diagnostics--related))
- `severity` (String) How serious a diagnostic is.
- `target` (String) The element it is about, as `step:<id>`, `stage:<id>`, `edge:<id>` or `component:<id>`.

<a id="nestedatt--files"></a>
### Nested Schema for `files`

Read-Only:

- `blob_sha` (String) The file's git object id at the commit it was read at; absent for a file not committed yet.
- `path` (String) The file's path from the repository's root, under `.gitmoap/pipelines/` — or, for a
component a check is sent, under `.gitmoap/components/`.
- `text` (String) The file's contents, at most 256 KiB.


<a id="nestedatt--published"></a>
### Nested Schema for `published`

Read-Only:

- `changed_since_latest` (Boolean) Whether the component's files differ from those its latest version was published from —
`true` means they hold something no version has published. Absent when there is no latest
version, or when it was published before versions recorded their files.
- `component_id` (String)
- `latest_version` (String)
- `version_count` (Number) How many versions have been published.


<a id="nestedatt--source_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_map`

Read-Only:

- `pointer` (String) JSON pointer into the definition or body beside it. In a pipeline's definition
`/stages/<s>/nodes/<n>` is a step's label, `/stages/<s>/nodes/<n>/config/<key>` a value of
its `with`, `/stages/<s>` a stage, `/edges/<i>` an edge and `/component_instances/<i>` a
component instance; in a component's body a step is at `/nodes/<i>/node`, and its contract at
`/parameters/<i>`, `/inputs/<i>` and `/outputs/<i>`.
- `provenance` (Attributes) How a part of a pipeline came by its value when its files do not write it out.

`kind` says which applies: `computed`; `defaulted`; `generated`, with `key`, `label`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_map--provenance))
- `source_map_location` (Attributes) A span of a file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_map--source_map_location))

<a id="nestedatt--source_map--provenance"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_map.provenance`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The instance's key.
- `kind` (String)
- `label` (String) The repeated block's label.
